title: QUICK PRO TR:ONE - FIRST LOOK

takeaways.text: Quick Pro says the non-UCI TR:ONE tested faster than its TT:ONE at Silverstone, especially with the rear storage fitted; it was designed with a former BMC chief executive.
The seatpost offers a wide effective seat-angle range, and the extensions adjust in length, angle, width and height; the base bar is shared with the TT:ONE.
Integrated hydration bladder with a drinking straw, a top-tube box for several gels and further storage behind the seatpost and on the frame.
Repeated figures: frame weight about 1,200 g, 32 mm clearance and a narrow T47 68 mm bottom bracket; the frameset package was quoted at about ¥21,800.

disclosure: China Cycling's founder runs Panda Podium, which will sell the bike; filmed at Quick Pro's launch event.
summary: A launch-event first look at the Quick Pro TR:ONE triathlon frameset.
